title: Composition and identity for the normalized scalar inverse-image comparison
statement: Fix the compatible ring sequences, bases and comparisons of [def-sf-system-finite-free-scalar-data]. For any composable scheme maps v:X→Y and w:Y→Z and N in Derived(A,Z), ell_(v≫w)(N) ≫ T_X(pComp_A(v,w)(N)) = pComp_B(v,w)(T_Z N) ≫ PB(v)(ell_w(N)) ≫ ell_v(PA(w)N). For every scheme X and N in Derived(A,X), ell_id(N) ≫ T_X(pId_A(X)(N)) = pId_B(X)(T_X N). Here pComp and pId are the prescribed inverse-image compositors of [def-sf-semilinear-proper-open-comparisons]. These identities are for inverse images only and do not assert any proper/open or direct-image scalar-mate equation.

proof.text: Use the section normalization of restrictionPush_existsUnique: the two pasted restriction/direct-image squares for v,w agree with the single square for v≫w under pushComp, because both are identity on sections. For identity morphisms compare with pushId, whose section map is the pullbackId site map. Conjugating by the scalar and inverse-image adjunctions gives the corresponding ordinary ellOrdinary equations. Applying the exact functors to complexes and localizing preserves these equations and inserts precisely the canonical pComp and pId comparisons. The equations hold for zero systems, identity maps, empty schemes and arbitrary unbounded complexes.

lean.statement:
theorem scalarInverseImageCoherence :
    (∀ {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (v : X ⟶ Y) (w : Y ⟶ Z) (N : Derived A a Z),
      (ell A B a b φ hφ d hd e (v ≫ w)).hom.app N ≫
          (T A B a b φ hφ d hd e X).map ((pComp A a v w).hom.app N) =
        (pComp B b v w).hom.app ((T A B a b φ hφ d hd e Z).obj N) ≫
          (P B b v).map ((ell A B a b φ hφ d hd e w).hom.app N) ≫
          (ell A B a b φ hφ d hd e v).hom.app ((P A a w).obj N)) ∧
    (∀ (X : Scheme.{u}) (N : Derived A a X),
      (ell A B a b φ hφ d hd e (𝟙 X)).hom.app N ≫
          (T A B a b φ hφ d hd e X).map ((pId A a X).hom.app N) =
        (pId B b X).hom.app ((T A B a b φ hφ d hd e X).obj N))
